# Replica Backend, add auth, database, payments and integrations to your app clone

Curated by Skill Harbor: the backend step of the Replica pack. Replica Backend replaces fake data with a working backend: email sign-up and OAuth with your own developer apps, checked-in database migrations with access rules tested against a second user, Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal in test mode with verified, idempotent webhooks, transactional email from your own domain, background jobs with retries, and integrations through official APIs only, all tracked against a security checklist. You create every account and key yourself; the agent never signs up, types a password, card or live key. By @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator.
